name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 33 killed at aid site; 76 missiles 3 Nov
summary: Toll from Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia aid point rises to 33; three days of mourning declared
state: Zelensky said on 3 Nov the toll from the 2 Nov Russian guided-bomb attack on an aid point in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, had risen to 33, with 48 missing; the regional governor declared mourning for 3–5 Nov (Censor.net, Ukrainska Pravda). Overnight into 3 Nov Russia launched 289 drones and 76 missiles at Ukraine, targeting power plants.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on power plants raise the risk of outages as winter begins.
rubric_hit: Mass-casualty strike on civilians (33 killed, 2 Nov) = significant escalation, Alert
